programme.title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Tapas Party! - MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of cheesy polenta and red pepper pesto, creamy paprika shrimp, curried lamb lollipops, salmon ceviche, and Korean kimbap.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Turf N' Surf - MORE One Big Recipe
programme.desc: Re-join Chef Kimberly Lallouz in her One Big Recipe test kitchen as she masterfully creates a week night feast of venison tartare, whole roasted maitake mushroom with a trio of sauces, seared scallops with a pea and fava bean puree and pepper relish, and a dandelion salad.

programme.title: S02 : E05 Comfort - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: In 30 minutes, chef Spencer Watts cooks up homey classics including a mouth-watering Chicken Stew and melt-in-your-mouth Herb Butter Biscuits.

programme.title: S02 : E06 That's Amore - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Chef Spencer Watts cooks up an Italian feast for four including a cheesy Cannelloni and a fast and fluffy Tiramisu.

programme.title: S01 : E05 Sweet Kisses - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.title: S01 : E06 Wow Factor - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Bone-in Veal Roast with an easy-to-execute and guaranteed-to-wow presentation is the apex of the event, with grainy mustard vinaigrette-dressed Charred Bok Choy halves. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: S01 : E11 Lobster Curry and More! - Pardon The Indigestion
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Lobster Curry and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: S01 : E12 Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and More! - Pardon The Indigestion
programme.desc: Enjoy a selection of recipes and food clips from Gusto TV, including Jerk Lobster Tails with Grilled Pineapple Salsa and more! Discover flavourful dishes, creative recipes, helpful cooking tips and plenty of inspiration for your next meal, with something delicious for every occasion.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spencer's Holiday BBQ - Spencer's Holiday BBQ
programme.desc: Join charismatic chef Spencer Watts at his glorious rooftop patio for a one-hour special featuring a full holiday spread, all made on the BBQ. Spencer’s festive menu is all about creative BBQ twists with his delectable, mouth-watering recipes including Burnt Orange Cranberry Marmalade, Maple Rye Pumpkin Pie, and Asparagus with Smoked Salmon Dip. Save room for the piece de Q-sistance: Smoked Turkey Two Ways. This year, take your holiday feast outside and serve up something deliciously different.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Thanksgiving - Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Get your 'Gobble Gobble' on with this special episode of Holiday Eatz, featuring fun and charming host Kimberly Lallouz! She starts her terrific Turkey Day menu with a harvest happy Kale Salad heaped with beets, candied pecans, toasted lentils, and goat cheese. Thanksgiving dinner needs Hot Rolls, Chef Lallouz packs hers with cranberries and corn, then serves them as a standalone course with a cheesy, creamy Mushroom Fondue! Next, it's time to talk turkey with a trick that cuts your poultry cooking time in half! Her Spatchcock Turkey is not just faster than old school, it's yummier too, with a garlic-herb marinade and a unique side of mixed beans and rice! Candied sweet potatoes and marshmallows make their perennial appearance here, but Chef Kimberly has a version that will fry"... your brain! Check out her Sweet Potato Churros with Marshmallow Creme for a presentation you"... do-nut"... want to miss!

programme.title: S01 : E1001 Pies Galore - Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: In preparation for a relaxing holiday with friends and family, FLOUR POWER THANKSGIVING: PIES GALORE invites you into the kitchen to bring a twist to your Thanksgiving classics. In this holiday special, host Jessica McGovern takes us through three new and exciting treats to bring to your table, sharing some of her favourite tips and tricks along the way. Jessica offers up three alternatives to a standard Thanksgiving dessert - serving up light and flaky Pie Fries with Apple Caramel Dip, a rich and creamy Sweet Potato Pie, and a luscious Vanilla Bourbon Sweet Potato Pie Cake coated in a fluffy marshmallow frosting. These quick and easy recipes will put you in the holiday spirit while adding a new taste to classic desserts.

programme.title: S01 : E01 BLITZ'N - BLITZ'N
programme.desc: Get ready for a special holiday BLITZ! with master mixologist Yvonne Langen as she prepares her favorite holiday cocktails and party snacks in the Gusto TV kitchen!

programme.title: S01 : E01 The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition - The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.sub-title: The Wizard of Whatever: Holiday Edition
programme.desc: Gusto TV’s Wizard of Whatever, Chef Kyle Crawford, is dishing up a holiday feast! There’ll be food, fun, elves… and even jolly old St. Nick himself may make an appearance! Join in as Kyle cooks up a Christmas goose complete with stuffing and gravy, plus all the sides and salads, and even a flashy flambé dessert! Merry whatever!

programme.title: S01 : E02 Twists on the Classics - Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is right around the corner and it calls for a little fun - like a twist on traditional holiday desserts! FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: TWISTS ON THE CLASSICS offers a new take on some of your favourites to bring you a fresh perspective and world of flavour for the holidays! Enchanting host Jessica McGovern plays off classic desserts, serving up handy hints on how to get the most out of every bite. From sweet and fluffy Gumdrop Cakes drizzled with a light lemony glaze to a delectable Eggnog Ski Slope Cake decorated with rosemary trees and a few friends to hit the hills, Jessica's unique holiday recipes will surly make it on your list of Christmas traditions!

programme.title: S01 : E01 One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes - One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.sub-title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Bonacini's Italian Christmas - Bonacini's Italian Christmas
programme.desc: BONACINI'S ITALIAN CHRISTMAS is a heartwarming one-hour holiday special featuring celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini as he shares some of his favourite Italian Christmas Eve dishes. Michael invites us to the set of his series "Bonacini's Italy" to cook up traditional Italian fare like Salt Cod Mousse on Polenta Crostini and Pork Braised in Milk. Michael takes us on a holiday culinary journey as he explores homey Christmas flavours and traditions, offering tips for perfecting dishes from the regions of Veneto, Sardinia, Calabria, Sicily, and Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: S01 : E1004 Big Wow Desserts - Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: The holidays are here! And the holidays come with a lineup of treats you won't be able to resist! From sweet and salty to traditional and unconventional, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: BIG WOW DESSERTS covers it all. To get in the holiday spirit, enchanting host Jessica McGovern introduces two desserts that could impress any Scrooge. First, Jessica bakes a decadent Chocolate Yule Log stuffed with a creamy Salted Caramel Frosting and finishes with a holiday-inspired cake decorated with homemade peppermint candy canes! Interwoven with tricks of the trade, Jessica guides us through her simple yet inspiring treats that are perfect for a big Christmas celebration.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Spencer's BIG Holiday - Spencer's Big Holiday
programme.desc: No matter how you celebrate the holidays, let Spencer Watts help you plan the menu, in SPENCER’S BIG HOLIDAY! In this festive one-hour holiday special, Spencer Watts is serving up some of his favourite holiday meals, treats, and drinks. Follow Spencer as he shows us how to sail through the hectic holiday season with style, from brunch to the moment the clock strikes midnight.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn - Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn
programme.sub-title: Maddie and Kiki's Holiday BBQ Barn
programme.desc: Fun-loving sisters and expert grillmasters Maddie and Kiki welcome you into their country barn to celebrate the holidays! They’re making a full menu of festive dishes on the BBQ – plus some drinks to get you in the party mood!

programme.title: S01 : E1003 Edible Gifts - Flour Power Holiday Specials
programme.desc: Christmas is near, and the pressure is on! Between work, home, friends, and family, the list of people to buy for is endless. To help us through this busy time, FLOUR POWER CHRISTMAS: EDIBLE GIFTS offers up four creative and more personal options to make the holidays cheaper, sweeter, and filled with love. Fun host Jessica McGovern shows us how to bake something for everyone including Crispy Brittle Bark covered in chocolate, rich Coal Cookies that are sweet with a bit of heat, adorable peanut butter-chocolate Reindeer Cupcakes, and easy-to-make Christmas Puzzle Cookies.

programme.title: S01 : E02 LIVEFEED Bluesfest Part 4 - LIVEFEED
programme.desc: The video captures a diverse range of musical performances, each with its own unique style and energy. Jesse Teasdale and Jade share their experiences running Golden Fries at Bluesfest Ottawa, highlighting the busy and memorable nights they have encountered. They discuss their popular menu items, including the classic poutine and crispy chicken poutine, and how they cater to large orders from artists and their crews. The video also features snippets of heartfelt and passionate lyrics from various songs, showcasing themes of love, longing, and personal reflection. Viewers will experience the dynamic atmosphere of Bluesfest Ottawa, the dedication of the Golden Fries team, and the emotional depth conveyed through the musical performances. This content offers a blend of culinary entrepreneurship, festival culture, and musical artistry.

programme.title: S01 : E08 Piemonte - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Piemonte cuisine is influenced by its mountainous terrain. Chef Michael Bonacini shows us how to make its warm regional dishes like Bagna Cauda.

programme.title: S01 : E09 Lombardy - Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Celebrity Chef Michael Bonacini prepares traditional dishes from the Northern Italian region, Lombardy.

programme.title: S03 : E22 Popular Athens Recipes - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: S02 : E02 SB30_S2E2_2015 - Spencer's Big 30
programme.desc: Host Spencer Watts cooks up a delicious Greek feast in around 30 minutes, for under 30 dollars.

programme.title: S03 : E23 Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Canada + Greece - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: S03 : E24 Hearty Greek Fare - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Leaves and Lettuces - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.desc: Golden Fries, a food truck venture founded by Jesse Teasdale and his wife, has become a popular spot at Bluesfest Ottawa. The truck, which started as a one-woman operation, quickly gained traction and now sees massive crowds, even requiring early gate openings for events like the Foo Fighters' performance. The menu highlights a classic poutine, made with fresh-cut fries, squeaky cheese curds, and rich gravy, as its top-selling item. The video captures various attendees raving about the quality and taste of the food, emphasizing the truck's commitment to using local, high-quality ingredients. Additionally, the video showcases the preparation and dedication that goes into running the truck, from early morning setups to handling large orders for bands and their crews. The narrative underscores the community spirit and the joy of sharing delicious food at live events.

programme.title: S03 : E22 Popular Athens Recipes - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Greek home cook Joanna Chery kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen by showcasing popular recipes from Athens. She begins by preparing Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki, a classic dish featuring succulent, beautifully charred chicken skewers and a refreshing cucumber yogurt garlic dipping sauce. Next, she fries up some deliciously flaky cod with an irresitble garlic-potato dip, a staple recipe for Greece's Independence Day. Another popular dish in the Greek culture is Lamb Fricassee. It includes crispy, browned lamb pieces, juicy beef stock and a lovely egg - so savoury! Don't forget, we need a perfect dessert to follow a rich and hearty lamb dish: fried dough balls. Joanna shows us her tricks for making them perfectly warm and crispy.

programme.title: S03 : E23 Olives: The Most Useful Ingredient - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Is there anything more Greek than olives? Host Joanna Chery shows us how versatile the olive really is by cooking up four diverse Greek dishes. To start, a rich, baked-to-perfection Olive Bread loaded with strong, slightly fruity black Kalamata olives. She then prepares a refreshing Greek Village Salad full of seasonal vegetables, creamy feta, and plump juicy olives tossed in extra virgin olive oil. And guess what? It pairs great with fried Olive Bread! Then, Joanna switches it up with wonderful green olives - the star in her delicious stuffing for Apricot and Feta-Stuffed Chicken Thighs. Finally, we're graced with a unique dessert - Saint Fanourios Cake. Joanna adds metaxa (Greek brandy), sweet dried apricots, and luscious olive oil for a moist dessert.

programme.title: S01 : E03 Canada + Greece - CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: S03 : E24 Hearty Greek Fare - One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Winters in Greece can get chilly, so fun host Joanna Chery warms us up with some hearty Greek dishes. First, she rolls up some tender Meatballs in a Lemon-Egg Sauce featuring a secret ingredient: rice (shh!). Then, she cooks a vegetarian stew that's packed with tasty artichokes, soft-boiled potatoes, and fragrant dill - great for a cool spring night. To finish, she makes a famous Greek dish called Moussaka. Traditionally eaten at Sunday dinner, this dish emulates the warmth of friends and family. Although it's a two part process - it's packed with layered vegetables, a hearty meat sauce and a creamy béchamel on top - it's so worth it!

programme.title: S01 : E06 Leaves and Lettuces - VegHeadz
programme.desc: Chef Pino Di Cerbo leaves no leaf behind in this exciting episode! Things kick off with a fresh salad full of crunchy cabbage and kale, topped with a mango vinaigrette. Then Pino gets wild with dolmades, grape leaves stuffed with wild rice and sweet caramelized onions. Next-up, French fries get friendly with foliage, served with a pile of fried herbs and homemade herb mayo for dipping. In his final creation, Pino reaches for the rainbow...of Swiss chard, that is! The colourful leaves get layered over creamy gorgonzola and puff pastry for a tart that will have you going back for more!

programme.title: S01 : E05 Sweet Kisses - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Who doesn't love Sweet Kisses? Join Chef Kimberly Lallouz as she showers them on her multi-course feast all laid out in One Big Recipe. Her Spicy Cornbread gets the first peck with lip-smacking Honey Butter. Then, it's a berry... nice smooch for a seared rare Duck Breast appetizer with Cherries and Walnuts. Avocado Honeydew Gazpacho follows, silky and savoury, with just a gentle sugary buss from the melon, it's a chilled soup gorgeously garnished with crostini and mascarpone. Citrus smooches Salmon on the main course, butter basted and presented with shattered dried citrus shards sprinkled over top and Basmati with Cranberries and Rice Vinegar alongside. Anyone can do it! It's all in the One Big Recipe.

programme.desc: What sets this cool One Big Recipe by charismatic chef-host Kimberly Lallouz apart? Folks, may I introduce the 'Wow Factor'? It's that hard- to-define special something, but we know it when we see it! Ogle her Chilled Mussels over Grilled Baguette lightly drizzled with vibrant, golden Saffron Aioli. Gasp at the golden gorgeous Roasted Mini Butternuts, ever so very vivacious with their Salsa Verde, tart Goat Cheese, and nutty toasted sunflower seed garnishes. Dessert gets a moment in the spotlight, summer berries draped with applause-inspiring vanilla whipped cream and sweet, crunchy Macadamia Streusel.

programme.title: S01 : E01 LIVEFEED Bluesfest Part 1 - LIVEFEED
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of Oxbury, Ontario, the Giant Pig Smokehouse opened in 2019, bringing Southern barbecue to life. The journey began in 2018 on Melissa's 30th birthday during a trip to Mexico when her brother proposed the idea of opening a restaurant. Embracing their love for smoked foods and recognizing the local events like Vankleek Hill Fair and Rib Fests, they decided to share their culinary passion beyond their home. The Giant Pig Smokehouse offers a variety of Southern barbecue dishes, with pulled pork poutine and brisket poutine being top sellers. Their pulled pork is described as sweet, saucy, and flavorful, often served in sandwiches or on poutines. The authenticity of their poutin gravy, made with meat drippings, is a highlight for many patrons. Customers praise the establishment for its delicious food and the welcoming atmosphere. Bianca from Gatineau, who tried the brisket poutine, found it amazing and fulfilling. McKenna and Matt from Alberta and Stoweville, Ontario, also shared their positive experiences, highlighting the quality of the barbecue and the friendly service. The owners emphasize the importance of patience in barbecue, advocating for slow cooking and marination to achieve the best flavors. They share their journey from backyard barbecues to a full-fledged restaurant, driven by their love for barbecue and the joy of sharing their creations with others. Working with family has its challenges and rewards. While the bond and trust are invaluable, there are moments of bickering that can be mistaken for conflict by customers. Despite these moments, the family's dedication to their craft and to each other shines through. The Giant Pig Smokehouse is not just a restaurant; it's a family business where love and dedication are infused into every dish. The secret to their success lies in the love and flavor they put into their food, ensuring every meal is as cherished as if it were served to their own family.

programme.desc: Well-traveled chef Kimberly Lallouz has familial ties to India, Morocco, and Spain, with culinary adventures from the Far East to the Deep South. Her 'Spiced Up!' One Big Recipe tries to tell a few chapters of that flavourful story on the plate. Starting on the milder side of the spice cabinet, Herbes de Provence inspires her Mediterranean Tomato Tart with Basil CrÃ¨me Fraiche. Next, South American spice meets northern ingredients in Arctic Char Ceviche with Rhubarb Vinaigrette. The centerpiece of her spice-studded supper is a Silk Road surprise, Cous-Cous Royale with Cornish Game Hens, Merguez Sausage and seasonal veggies. programme.title: S01 : E08 Vegetarian Dinner - One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Protein-packed plant-based foods are on the One Big Recipe for chef Kimberly Lallouz's Vegetarian Dinner, five fun, filling courses designed for both vegetarians and omnivores. First up is yummy White Bean Hummus, served with pita, topped with savoury Caramelized Onion Jam and fried sage. Next is umami-packed Grilled Treviso Salad with arugula pesto, red grapes, and pine nuts. Brussels Sprouts shine in her Kimchi-inspired Korean take, topped with crunchy brown butter cashews. Salt Crusted Potato with Chive Oil will wow even the most skeptical carnivore in your orbit, and to finish, Pasta Giardina is a painting on a plate, tossing together multi-hued ribbons of garden veggies with fresh peas, mint, and a crumble of satisfying ricotta salata cheese.

programme.title: S4:E3 Estefania de Monaco - Royals

programme.title: S1:E8 Episodio 8 - Universo Starlite

programme.title: Opera - Salome
programme.desc: The 87th Festival of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino opens with Richard Strauss's Salome, conducted by Alexander Soddy. Directed by Emma Dante, this new production features Lidia Fridman as Salome, Anna Maria Chiuri as Herodias, and Nikolai Schukoff as Herodes. The performance blends Strauss's intense musical drama with a fresh and dynamic staging.

programme.title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 7 - Conferences, Startups and Innovation
programme.desc: A new world is being built right now across the Mediterranean, and we are taking you behind the scenes of the most important meetings of the year. This week, we are at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for MedTech World, where the conversation has shifted from simple gadgets to responsible AI that doctors and patients can actually trust. We then head south to the incredible energy of AfricaIgnite to meet the founders of high-growth startups in climate tech and finance who are proving that Africa is the new engine of global innovation. Back on the islands, we explore the Startup Malta Festival to see how a pro-business ecosystem is helping entrepreneurs scale their boldest ideas across Europe. Finally, we join the global dialogue at the Finance Malta Conference to see how a focus on quality over quantity is redefining the future of investment and sustainability. This is a journey through the ideas and the people who are turning today's challenges into the success stories of the future.

programme.title: Gold Cuisine EP 4
programme.desc: Chryso Lefou makes a light and tasty Mediterranean dish with fresh pasta, colourful mint pesto, and juicy cherry tomatoes. She makes crispy fried almond fingers (Dactyla) for dessert, which adds a nutty, sweet finish. A delectable blend of decadent treats and savoury, fresh flavours.

programme.title: Malini Angelica Barcelona
programme.desc: Barcelona, Spain, is a city close to Malini's heart. Returning after her student years, she retraces old steps to see how the city has changed. Barcelona, one of Europe’s most visited cities, still holds centuries-old charm. Malina's old haunts include El Gòtic, Sant Antoni, Passeig de Gràcia, and Barceloneta. visits Gaudí’s iconic Casa La Pedrera, and discovers the new wave of creative tapas restaurants in El Raval, a once run-down quarter now bursting with energy.

programme.title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.sub-title: Made in Med: Legacy of stone sculpture
programme.desc: From rough blocks of stone to expressive works of art, Reuben Mallia reveals the patience and skill behind traditional Mediterranean stone carving. Fadi steps into his world to discover how simple tools, careful craftsmanship, and countless hours of work can bring solid rock to life.

programme.title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 8 - Books Literature Innovation and Learning
programme.desc: Great ideas are the lifeblood of the Mediterranean and this week we are following them from the written page to the boardroom. We start at the Malta Book Festival, where the local community gathers to celebrate the stories that define the islands. Our journey then takes us to Cyprus for the Nicosia Book Fest to see how literature creates a unique bridge between cultures. In Spain, we wander the famous leafy avenues of the Madrid Book Fair, where Retiro Park becomes one of the largest outdoor libraries in the world. We wrap up at the historic Mediterranean Conference Centre in Valletta for the EU Startup Summit, where the creative energy of storytelling meets the high-stakes world of global innovation. This is a look at the parks and the halls where the next chapter of the Mediterranean is being written.

programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Whats On - 20 -ONLY DECEMBER- Mediterranean Winter Wonders
programme.sub-title: Whats On - 20 -ONLY DECEMBER- Mediterranean Winter Wonders
programme.desc: While much of Europe slows down for the winter, the cities of Ljubljana and Chartres are just waking up. It's time to start exploring two destinations that use light to tell incredible stories across their ancient walls. Starting in Slovenia, where the capital city transforms into a glowing laboratory of art. Instead of traditional decorations, Ljubljana features a unique universe-themed display where the streets are draped in glowing galaxies and mathematical equations that celebrate the mysteries of science. From there, we travel to France for the spectacular Noël à Chartres. Here, the historic cathedral and over twenty medieval sites become a massive outdoor gallery. Using world-class projections, the city tells its thousand-year history through vibrant colours that dance across the Gothic architecture. It is a journey through two cities that prove winter is the most beautiful time to see the world

programme.title: S01 : E01 Guía XP Oslo 1, Noruega - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Oslo es la más antigua de las capitales escandinavas; Con una rica historia que se remonta a más de 1000 años, los monumentos icónicos de la ciudad revelan a los visitantes su evolución a través de los tiempos. Elisha realiza un recorrido para ver algunos de ellos, como el magnífico Castillo de Arkeshus, un castillo medieval que fue construido para proteger Oslo pero que en su lugar se usó como prisión, y el Ayuntamiento de Oslo, el centro administrativo de la ciudad que alberga la entrega anual del Nobel. Ceremonia del premio de la paz.

programme.title: S01 : E21 Espacios en la Ciudad Narlai & Jawai - City Breaks

programme.title: S01 : E02 Guía XP Oslo 2, Noruega - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Quizás el período más famoso de la historia de Noruega fue la época vikinga. Lejos de ser simples invasores bárbaros y con hachas, los vikingos eran marinos nórdicos que dejaron un gran impacto en la historia europea a través del comercio, la colonización y la exploración remota. Durante la visita de Elisha a Oslo, queda asombrada por los extraordinarios y bien diseñados barcos vikingos en un museo, donde conoce historias fascinantes sobre la vida de los vikingos.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Viajar Mexico Oaxaca - Viajar Mexico

programme.desc: En el Evason Ma'In Resort en Jordania, Jamie prueba los tratamientos de spa Srubis que aprovechan las propiedades curativas de las cercanas aguas termales de Hammamat Ma'In.

programme.title: S01 : E52 Guía XP Muscat - Xp Guide
programme.desc: Muscat, que se extiende a lo largo de casi 25 kilómetros a lo largo de la costa de Omán, combina el glamour del nuevo mundo y el encanto del viejo mundo para brindar a los visitantes una muestra de la verdadera Arabia.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora España Barcelona 1 - Xplore Spain
programme.desc: Desde la tierra del sagrado estadio Camp Nou hasta la capital catalana con increíbles mariscos, Barcelona es una ciudad con muchos matices.

programme.title: S01 : E24 Espacios en la Ciudad Bikaner - City Breaks
programme.desc: Bikaner es conocida por la mayoría de la gente como la ciudad de los bocadillos salados de fama mundial. Sin embargo, cuando Asmita va allí para un viaje relámpago, descubre que hay mucho más en la Ciudad Roja de Rajasthan de lo que parece. Desde las pinturas en miniatura que se pueden encontrar en las paredes de palacios y mansiones de toda la ciudad hasta la elaborada arquitectura de los antiguos havelis de comerciantes, descubre que Bikaner es un paraíso para los amantes del arte.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

programme.title: S01 : E04 Mochila Bali, Indonesia - Backpack
programme.desc: Bali, un escondite tropical, logra ser un paraíso para los buscadores de aventuras, un santuario espiritual, un paraíso para los amantes de la comida y el retiro de un entusiasta de la naturaleza, todo al mismo tiempo. Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

Esto es algo que Hannah Jackson descubre por sí misma mientras explora los templos de Bali, como el templo de Ulan Danu, prueba mariscos deliciosos y ultrafrescos, disfruta de algunas actividades de aventura como un paseo por el mar y visita un criadero de tortugas.

programme.title: S01 : E07 Grandiosos Hoteles Del Mundo Huvafen Fushi 1, Maldives - Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Un viaje a Maldivas es como un viaje a un gran paraíso de aguas azules. Una villa con piso, que ofrece vistas claras del océano turquesa y la exquisita vida marina bajo sus pies, realza esta experiencia para Kim durante su visita. Se mima aún más con un tratamiento de spa bajo el agua y una botella de vino de una bodega subterránea, que es como una cueva del tesoro para los conocedores del vino de todo el mundo.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Fuera Del Mapa Wild Atlantic Way 1, Irlanda - Off The Grid
programme.desc: Al comenzar su viaje por la Ruta Atlántica Salvaje desde Dublín, Alex planea conducir hasta el final y hace su primera parada en "Cliffs of Moher". Luego se detiene en el pueblo de Kildare y comprende la cultura irlandesa. Visita el Centro de Arte Claddagh. Además, su siguiente parada es el Castillo de Ashford, que ahora es una propiedad de lujo de 5 estrellas y luego la Escuela de Falcony de Irlanda. Más adelante en su viaje, visita a Croagh Patrick en Westport y luego, al finalizar el episodio, recorre 60 kilómetros en bicicleta hasta Mulranny.

programme.title: S01 : E01 Xplora Omán Muscat - Xplore Oman
programme.desc: En una visita a Mascate, la capital de Omán, Elisha Kriis se encuentra boquiabierta ante la magnificencia de la Gran Mezquita del Sultán Qaboos, que domina el horizonte de la ciudad. Mientras se pierde en los tesoros de Oriente Medio en el famoso Muttrah Souq, comienza a experimentar los clásicos encantos árabes de Omán.

programme.title: S01 : E01 10 Días En Corea Seoul - 10 Days Korea
programme.desc: Seúl, la capital de Corea del Sur, es una ciudad dinámica que forja sin miedo un camino hacia el futuro preservando fielmente sus raíces. Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.

Andrew Maciver, adicto a los viajes, prueba las delicias locales en los Pojangmachas, carritos de comida callejera típicos coreanos, de los animados mercados de Myeongdong. También ve las atracciones icónicas de la ciudad, como el templo Jogyesa, Daedongmun, que es la puerta este de la ciudad, y el palacio Gyeongbokgung, que alguna vez sirvió como sede de uno de los imperios más grandes del Asia medieval.
